test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If every letter in the word IMAGINATION is changed to the next letter in the English alphabetical order and the letters of the new word thus formed are arranged in alphabetical order, which letter will be the sixth from the left end of the new word thus formed? Note: The new word formed after performing the mentioned operations may not necessarily be a meaningful English word.
solution:
Given word: 'IMAGINATION'

After changing each letter to the next letter in the English alphabetical order:

JNBHJOBUJPO

After arranged in alphabetical order:

 
 

 Alphabets
 J
 N
 H
 B
 J
 O
 B
 U
 J
 P
 O
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 B
 B
 H
 J
 J
 **J**
 N
 O
 O
 P
 U
 
 

 

Thus, letter will be the sixth from the left end of the new word is "J".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
